title: Paul McCartney live: Allianz Parque, São Paulo | 2019
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Allianz Parque stadium in São Paulo, Brazil, on 27 March 2019.

It was the 22nd show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019, and the second of two consecutive nights in São Paulo.

Quando @PaulMcCartney mostrou a música para John Lennon, ele pensou, em parte, que era dedicado a ele e Yoko Ono, com quem estava começando um relacionamento
 #PaulMcCartney #AllianzParque #FreshenUpTour pic.twitter.com/w3luooTNNc

— Allianz Parque (@AllianzParque) March 28, 2019

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

During the encore McCartney led a version of ‘Happy Birthday To You’ for Wix.

McCartney had previously performed at the Allianz Parque stadium on 25 and 26 November 2014 during the Out There Tour, and 15 October 2017 for the One On One Tour. He returned on 7, 9, and 10 December 2023, and 15 and 16 October 2024 for the Got Back Tour.
